name: Remote Sensing of the Earth
summary: Observing the Earth from aircraft and satellites: the physics of sensing, image processing and applications.

topics.name: Electromagnetic radiation and interactions with the atmosphere and surface
Spectral signatures of rocks, soils, water, vegetation and snow
Sensors, platforms and orbits (Landsat, Sentinel, MODIS)
Spatial, spectral, radiometric and temporal resolution
Image enhancement and spectral indices (e.g. NDVI)
Image classification: supervised, unsupervised and machine learning
Radar and SAR imaging; introduction to InSAR
Cloud platforms for Earth observation (e.g. Google Earth Engine)
